source_programme.title: V. (D-dúr) Brandenburgi Verseny Bwv 1050 = Brandenburg Concerto No. 5 In D Major

entries.source_notes:
This release is a historical recording, recorded live in the studio of Hungarian Radio on 13th January, 1950. This is part 1 (hence the 1 in the title) of the series of live recordings of Klemperer entitled: "Klemperer In Budapest (1948-1950 Live Recordings)". This whole title appears on the front cover, as well as the titles of the works. The title of this release in hungarian (printed on back cover) reads: Klemperer Budapesten — 1.
The liner notes are in Hungarian; the tracklisting is in Hungarian and English.
Comes with as 12" booklet with information in English, French, German and russian.

The complete durations are printed on the LP; Track A1d and A1k are listed without their duration.

Copyright notices:
Royalties collection society: ℗ 1979 Artisjus (printed on LP)
Made in Hungary ℗ 1980

entries.source_notes:
℗ 1968 Ⓒ 1972, 3/1975 TELDEC »Telefunken-Decca« Schallplatten GmbH. Made & printed in Germany.
Concentus Musicus Wien with original instruments.

The gate-fold sleeve has 8-pages stapled in the middle.
These extra pages are about the Complete Cantatas of J.S. Bach made by Harnoncourt c.s. / Telefunken.
They contain an interview with Nikolaus Harnoncourt and additional notes in German, English and French.
Also lots of black & white photos and a catalog of Telefunken releases with press reviews.
There is also a list of releases who won international awards.

The sleeve notes are in German, English and French.
Front & back cover painting: "Die flämische Kirmes" by David Teniers (1610-1690);
Museum der schönen Künste (Brüssel) / Archiv Für Kunst und Geschichte.

This reissue has a sticker with the logo "aspekte" in white and "TELEFUNKEN" in black,
covering the space (high, left corner on the front) where in the earlier version "Das Alte Werk" appeared.
On the blue labels the logo of "Das Alte Werk" still appears.
On the back cover a sticker with "AH" has been fetched to cover up the marking of "AS" as suffix of the catalog# 6.41359.
